experiment: Exact 32K context feasibility with phase-aware cache fitting

environment.hardware: MacBook Air Mac14,2, Apple M2, 8 GiB unified memory
environment.storage: active runtime artifact on internal APFS Apple Fabric storage
environment.cache_state: empty stable cache, F_NOCACHE expert reads
environment.host_state: Safari and VS Code were closed; Codex/ChatGPT remained open

observation.measured_mlx_peak_reason_missing: MLX peak telemetry is emitted only in the completed result object; the process was interrupted during prefill.
observation.live_stack_sample: Main thread waited on MLX/Metal IOSurface events while demand-worker threads were active in native preadv; the process was working, not deadlocked.

decision.status: rejected as unusable on the current exact path
decision.reason: The 32K prompt had not completed prefill after about 52 minutes and grew swap by about 1.10 GiB. Completion would not make that TTFT useful.
decision.deferred_work: A smaller prefill chunk reduced memory in prior testing but changed router decisions and output. Deep chunk-boundary/kernel-state equivalence work is deferred rather than weakening correctness.
decision.next_action: Measure one heterogeneous, non-repeated 16K document workload.
